messages:
maya (product): Quick sync — we need a lightweight way to decide what gets pulled into sprint-1 after GA. proposing a 'gatekeeper' list (must-fix) + 'slice credits' for enhancements.
sam (eng): +1. can we quantify gatekeeper? p0 = customer-impacting crash or data-loss; p1 = regression in core flow.
lee (sre): Need to add infra incidents: pages that surface as p0 should block merge unless hotfix plan submitted.
olivia (qa): Can we agree on acceptance criteria for p1 fixes? e.g., regression test + perf check. reduces rework.
alexa (cs): From early adopter calls: top signal is latency spikes on multi-turn chat and occasional hallucinations. those feel p0/p1 mix.
maya (product): Proposal: sprint budget = 40% gatekeeper, 40% enhancement via slice credits, 20% buffer for ops/hotfixes. slice credits = 1 credit per small enhancement, 3 for medium, 5 for large.
sam (eng): how do teams earn/transfer credits? borrowing across squads is common
maya (product): earn by closing legacy debt tickets or swapping planned scope. transfer allowed with PM sign-off.
olivia (qa): QA time needs to be reserved per credit size. small=2 hrs, med=6 hrs, large=2 days.
lee (sre): also require rollback plan for any enhancement touching serving runtime — counts as 'large' unless proven isolated.
alexa (cs): cherry on top: prioritize enhancements that unblock paying customers first. we'll provide a ranked list by EBM.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 2025-06-12 02:00 UTC. Will block if any p0 is unresolved at 24h cutoff.
maya (product): Action items: alexa send ranked customer list by EOD, sam draft gatekeeper rubric, olivia map QA effort to credits. We'll reconvene 10:30am tomorrow.
sam (eng): I'll put a draft doc in the roadmap board and tag the squads. :thumbsup:
olivia (qa): noted. will estimate on Monday sprint plan.
maya (product): thanks all — aim is to keep the rollout moving while protecting SLAs. :rocket:
